concept: trend discovery engine with customer value return
thesis: Do not optimize only for identifying what may become popular and monetizing attention. Design each loop so the customer receives additional durable value beyond the underlying product.

candidate_signals: early acceleration rather than raw popularity
conversion or action signals when lawfully available
trend_side.forecast_rule: freeze predictions before outcomes and score later; never rewrite misses as hits

value_types: learn why a trend is or is not suitable
build a personal taste or preference history
build a portable collection, progress or decision record
receive transparent benefits for voluntary useful contribution
gain recognition or community participation without artificial scarcity or coercion
customer_return_side.fashion_example: A user who helps rate or test a trend should receive better personal matching, clearer reasoning, saved decisions, and optional transparent rewards rather than merely donating engagement data.
future_cross_domain_examples: beauty: saved routine and avoided bad purchases
fitness: progress history and safer next-step recommendations
hobbies: collection/progress history and better tool decisions
travel: reusable preference profile and planning time saved
consumer trends: early discovery plus later forecast scorecards

clean_growth_constraints: no undisclosed sponsored influence on trend scores
no artificial lock-in disguised as customer value
reward contribution only when terms and value exchange are understandable
hundred_user_phase_questions: Did users receive value even if they bought nothing?
Did the service prevent a bad decision or save meaningful time?
Did saved history make the next visit better?
Would users voluntarily contribute ratings or outcomes because they also benefit?
Can the return loop work without cash subsidies?
Does the loop remain useful if one social platform weakens?
